## Summary of change
Explain what changed and why it is needed.

## Related Jira issue(s)
Link the corresponding sprint issue(s) or explain why no issue was created.

## Risk and impact
Describe affected components, deployment implications, and potential security impact.

## Tests and evidence
List local checks and link relevant CI runs or test reports. Do not claim a test passed before it was run.

## Rollback plan
Describe how to safely revert the change (for example, reverting the merge commit) and any special data or deployment considerations.

## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] The changes match the stated scope.
- [ ] Automated checks passed or any failures are explained.
- [ ] Risk and rollback were reviewed.
- [ ] A reviewer other than the author approved, if required by repository rules.

> This template helps capture CC8.1 change records. It does not enforce approvals or branch protection; configure those separately in GitHub repository settings.
